title: Presentation of a geometric morphism by a continuous finite-limit site functor
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be small categories with precoverages $J,K$ containing isomorphisms, stable under composition and base change and admitting pullbacks [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $L:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,K)\rightleftarrows\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J):R$ be an adjunction with $L$ preserving finite limits. Then there exist small finite-limit categories $\mathcal C^{\prime},\mathcal D^{\prime}$, precoverages $J^{\prime},K^{\prime}$ satisfying those four axioms, equivalences $g:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,J)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C^{\prime},J^{\prime})$ and $e:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D,K)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D^{\prime},K^{\prime})$, and a finite-limit-preserving continuous functor $v:\mathcal D^{\prime}\to\mathcal C^{\prime}$ sending every covering presieve to a covering presieve. There is a natural isomorphism $R\mathbin{\cdot}e_*\cong g_*\mathbin{\cdot}v_*$, where $\cdot$ denotes composition in diagram order and $v_*$ is precomposition on sheaves along $v^{\mathrm{op}}$.

source.place: Tag 03A2 (lemma-morphism-topoi-comes-from-morphism-sites) and Remark 03CJ, simultaneous replacement by finite-limit sites.

proof.text: Apply compatible generators and the epimorphic-precoverage comparison on both sides, obtaining G,E,v and a:vG≅EL. To see that v preserves covers, take two maps out of G(vT) equal after the image family; precompose by a inverse and transpose through L ⊣ R. The resulting maps out of E(T) are equal by joint cancellation of the original cover. The Hom bijection and a then reflect equality. Preservation of finite limits and covers gives continuity by Mathlib Functor.isContinuous_toGrothendieck_of_pullbacksPreservedBy.

For X and T define Hom(E(T),R(X)) ≃ Hom(G(v(T)),X) by adjunction followed by composition with a at T; its inverse composes with a inverse before transposing. Adjunction naturality in each variable and naturality of a give the two naturality equations. Assemble the bijections into a natural isomorphism of nerves, conjugate by the two comparison nerve isomorphisms, and cancel the fully faithful inclusion of sheaves into presheaves using Mathlib Functor.fullyFaithfulCancelRight. No Yoneda hom-bijection node or site inverse-image/tensor theorem is used.

theorem topos_sitePresentation
    {C D : Type u} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : Precoverage C) (K : Precoverage D)
    [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition] [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks]
    [K.HasIsos] [K.IsStableUnderComposition] [K.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [K.HasPullbacks]
    (L : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (R : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type u))
    (adj : L ⊣ R) [PreservesFiniteLimits L] :
    ∃ (C' D' : Type u) (_ : SmallCategory C') (_ : SmallCategory D')
      (J' : Precoverage C') (K' : Precoverage D')
      (_ : J'.HasIsos) (_ : J'.IsStableUnderComposition)
      (_ : J'.IsStableUnderBaseChange) (_ : J'.HasPullbacks)
      (_ : K'.HasIsos) (_ : K'.IsStableUnderComposition)
      (_ : K'.IsStableUnderBaseChange) (_ : K'.HasPullbacks)
      (_ : HasFiniteLimits C') (_ : HasFiniteLimits D')
      (g : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type u) ≌ Sheaf J'.toGrothendieck (Type u))
      (e : Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type u) ≌ Sheaf K'.toGrothendieck (Type u))
      (v : D' ⥤ C') (_ : PreservesFiniteLimits v)
      (_ : v.IsContinuous K'.toGrothendieck J'.toGrothendieck),
      (∀ (T : D') (S : Presieve T), S ∈ K' T → S.map v ∈ J' (v.obj T)) ∧
      Nonempty (R ⋙ e.functor ≅ g.functor ⋙
        v.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type u) K'.toGrothendieck J'.toGrothendieck)
